vb_textbox.text: At first, I chose off of colour, to see how many mushrooms I was given but then realised that it wasn't always definite how many I would receive. Even when looking at the set colour combinations the positions that the gnomes were in weren't always the same. However, in the last round I started choosing between 's' and 'k' in an alternating pattern, which I felt worked best. As in that round I didn't get any 0 number mushrooms. So I believe to try alternating between 's' and 'k' will give the best result. I am not sure which one first so you will have to trial a couple times to see which start works out best.
